title: 水电站的白天与夜间运行
prompt: Describe how a hydroelectric station operates during the day and at night, including the direction of water movement and electricity generation.
book_ref: 剑雅 14 Academic · Test 3 · Writing Task 1

stages: DAY: River water is stored in a high-level reservoir behind a dam
DAY: An open intake allows water to flow downhill to reversible turbines
DAY: Turbines drive a generator; electricity enters the national grid
DAY: Used water enters the low-level reservoir
NIGHT: The intake is closed and turbines pump water uphill
NIGHT: Water returns to the high-level reservoir for reuse
